style: Thick angular navy outlines; broad matte base colors with one polygon shadow; geometric cream/ochre wood and burgundy velvet. New plum/wine/lavender/dusty-rose sky.
groundConnectivity: G/W/S share full 8-neighbor ground occupancy for connected organic top masks.
carpetPolicy: S is a visual overlay on existing stage occupancy. It never creates collision or floor. Support grouping normalizes S to G including PRNG and endpoint continuity. S support PNGs are compatibility-only; never duplicate G supports.
supportPolicy: Normalize S to G before grouping, endpoint selection and deterministic random seeds. 1–4 contiguous cells share a fused underside; longer G/S runs use grouped bodies plus a continuous shallow collar. W is continuous structural catwalk with void-side rails only.
deviceBindingPolicy: Use exact heading/state clips and full six-face dice orientation; resolve actual project IDs/events without guessing.
sourcePolicy: P01 replaces only gate/wind for Ranch and gate/domino/bookcase for Theater. Other approved runtime PNGs remain byte-identical. Actual Unity binding verification is NOT_RUN.
